patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column grid for initial content sections, featuring a large image on one side and a heading with a smaller image/link on the other, creating visual tension and interest.
Strong contrast between oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings and smaller, elegant, condensed serif text for navigation, body copy, and calls to action.
A minimalist black and white base palette is heavily augmented by the rich, naturalistic colors and tones present in the full-bleed photography, which serves as the primary source of color.

As the user scrolls, the main content sections scroll normally, but a fixed top navigation remains visible. A distinctive effect occurs in the lower section where a block of text remains fixed in the viewport while its full-bleed background image dynamically transitions through a sequence of different photographs.
The site features a mission statement section with text overlaid on a full-bleed background image, which then dynamically changes to other images as the user scrolls, creating a cinematic reveal.

technique_notes: To achieve the dynamic background effect, a section's text content is positioned to remain fixed in the viewport, while its background image is swapped or transitioned using CSS keyframes or a WebGL-based animation library as the user scrolls to different depths within that section.
The navigation bar at the top of the page is implemented as a sticky element, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, contrasted with smaller, elegant, condensed serif text for navigation and descriptive copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used for all image frames and content blocks, contributing to a clean and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, particularly in the hero and initial content sections, with generous whitespace around images and text, creating a gallery-like feel. The footer is more dense with logos.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the cinematic scroll-triggered background image transitions. A block of text remains fixed while a sequence of full-bleed, high-quality photographs fades or slides in behind it, creating a highly engaging and editorial visual narrative.
